name: NDA check against counsel's approved positions
summary: Before anyone signs a proposed NDA, counsel gets every clause quoted with its section and set beside the positions counsel has approved: matching, departing or not covered. Any obligation beyond confidentiality sends the whole NDA to counsel. The check never says an NDA is ready to sign.

sources.contribution: The idea of measuring an NDA only against a lawyer's written positions for the company's side, stopping when those positions are missing, supplying no default where they are silent, sending any NDA that binds a party to more than confidentiality to a lawyer, not telling the other side the company will sign before a lawyer has decided, and the range of topics such positions may cover.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's comparison method: every clause quoted beside the position it was measured against, per-clause marks, a line for each position the NDA does not address, a fixed rule for what counts as a difference, a confirm line for each defined term read as an ordinary word, flags that name their list item word for word, a review-date check on the positions file, and every result, a full match included, addressed to counsel as a draft for counsel to decide and sign, never routed to signature.
